23386-in-the-king-s-name-the-cruise-of-t.creator: Unknown
23386-in-the-king-s-name-the-cruise-of-t.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. look in the Channel when the bright sun is shining, and the arch above reflects itself in its bosom. The gulls floated half asleep on the water, with one eye open and the other closed; and the pale-grey kittiwakes seemed to glide about on the wing, to dip down here and there and cleverly snatch a tiny fish from the surface of the softly heaving sea.

arxiv-2012-07597.title: Global Λ \Lambda polarization in moderately relativistic nuclear collisions
arxiv-2012-07597.creator: Yu. B. Ivanov
arxiv-2012-07597.description: Abstract Predictions for the global polarization of Λ \Lambda hyperons in Au+Au collisions at moderately relativistic collision energies, 2.4 ≤ s N ​ N ≤ \leq\sqrt{s_{NN}}\leq 11 GeV, are made. These are based on the thermodynamic approach to the global polarization incorporated into the model of the three-fluid dynamics. Centrality dependence of the polarization is studied.

arxiv-2202-04694.title: Emergent Non-Abelian Gauge Theory in Coupled Spin-Electron Dynamics
arxiv-2202-04694.creator: Nicolas Lenzing, Alexander I. Lichtenstein, Michael Potthoff
arxiv-2202-04694.description: Abstract A clear separation of the time scales governing the dynamics of “slow” and “fast” degrees of freedom often serves as a prerequisite for the emergence of an independent low-energy theory. Here, we consider (slow) classical spins exchange coupled to a tight-binding system of (fast) conduction electrons.

arxiv-2206-06861.title: The Stieltjes–Fekete problem and degenerate orthogonal polynomials
arxiv-2206-06861.description: Abstract A result of Stieltjes famously relates the zeroes of the classical orthogonal polynomials with the configurations of points on the line that minimize a suitable energy with logarithmic interactions under an external field. The optimal configuration satisfies an algebraic set of equations: we call this set of algebraic equations the Stieltjes–Fekete problem.

arxiv-2207-05960.title: Visualizing heterogeneous dipole fields by terahertz light coupling in individual nano-junctions used in transmon qubits
arxiv-2207-05960.creator: R. H. J. Kim, J. M. Park, S. Haeuser, C. Huang, D. Cheng, T. Koschny, J. Oh, C. Kopas, H. Cansizoglu, K. Yadavalli, J. Mutus, L. Zhou, L. Luo, M. Kramer, J. Wang
arxiv-2207-05960.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by R. H. J. Kim, J. M. Park, S. Haeuser, C. Huang, D. Cheng, T. Koschny, J. Oh, C. Kopas, H. Cansizoglu, K. Yadavalli, J. Mutus, L. Zhou, L. Luo, M. Kramer, J. Wang. The fundamental challenge underlying superconducting quantum computing is to characterize heterogeneity and disorder in the underlying quantum circuits. These nonuniform distributions often lead to local electric field concentration, charge scattering, dissipation and ultimately decoherence.

arxiv-2303-09213.title: Perfect synchronization in complex networks with higher order interactions
arxiv-2303-09213.creator: Sangita Dutta 1, Prosenjit Kundu 2, Pitambar Khanra 3, Chittaranjan Hens 4, Pinaki Pal 1
arxiv-2303-09213.description: Abstract We propose a framework for achieving perfect synchronization in complex networks of Sakaguchi-Kuramoto oscillators in presence of higher order interactions (simplicial complexes) at a targeted point in the parameter space. It is achieved by using an analytically derived frequency set from the governing equations.

arxiv-2305-08667.title: A Note on Rules Achieving Optimal Metric Distortion
arxiv-2305-08667.creator: Jannik Peters
arxiv-2305-08667.description: Abstract In this note, we uncover three connections between the metric distortion problem and voting methods and axioms from the social choice literature. 1 Introduction The distortion of voting rules was introduced by Procaccia and Rosenschein 2006 as a way to implicitly measure the utilitarian performance of a voting rule.

arxiv-2310-00993.title: Self-consistent modeling of the energetic storm particle event of 10 November 2012
arxiv-2310-00993.creator: A. Afanasiev, R. Vainio, D. Trotta, S. Nyberg, N. Talebpour Sheshvan, H. Hietala, N. Dresing
arxiv-2310-00993.description: Abstract Context. It is thought that solar energetic ions associated with coronal/interplanetary shock waves are accelerated to high energies by the diffusive shock acceleration mechanism. In order to be efficient, this mechanism requires intense magnetic turbulence in the vicinity of the shock.

arxiv-2403-05548.title: Monitoring the evolution of antisemitic discourse on extremist social media using BERT Thanks: Acknowledgements: Research supported by American University’s Signature Research Initiative program. We also thank Matan Schwartz for his initial help with this project.
arxiv-2403-05548.creator: Raza Ul Mustafa, Nathalie Japkowicz
arxiv-2403-05548.description: Abstract Racism and intolerance on social media contribute to a toxic online environment which may spill offline to foster hatred, and eventually lead to physical violence. That is the case with online antisemitism, the specific category of hatred considered in this study.

arxiv-2407-08451.title: Dominance to egalitarian transition in diverse communities
arxiv-2407-08451.creator: David A. Kessler and Nadav M. Shnerb
arxiv-2407-08451.description: Abstract Diverse communities of competing species are generally characterized by substantial niche overlap and strongly stochastic dynamics. Abundance fluctuations are proportional to population size, so the dynamics of rare populations is slower. Hence, once a population becomes rare, its abundance gets stuck at low values. Here, we analyze the effect of this phenomenon on community structure.

arxiv-2409-14504.title: On the Euler class one conjecture for fillable contact structures Thanks: Partially supported by NSFC Grant 11925101, and National Key R&D Program of China 2020YFA0712800
arxiv-2409-14504.creator: Yi Liu
arxiv-2409-14504.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yi Liu. In this paper, it is proved that every oriented closed hyperbolic 3 3 –manifold N N admits some finite cover M M with the following property. There exists some even lattice point w w on the boundary of the dual Thurston norm unit ball of M M , such that w w is not the real Euler class of any weakly symplectically fillable contact structure on M M .

arxiv-2508-15363.title: An adaptive procedure for detecting replicated signals with k k -family-wise error rate control Thanks: This research was supported by The University of Melbourne’s Research Computing Services, the Petascale Campus Initiative, and the Australian Government Research Training Program (RTP) Scholarship
arxiv-2508-15363.creator: Ninh Tran
arxiv-2508-15363.description: Abstract . Partial conjunction (PC) hypothesis testing is widely used to assess the replicability of scientific findings across multiple comparable studies. In high-throughput meta-analyses, testing a large number of PC hypotheses with k k -family-wise error rate ( k k -FWER) control often suffers from low statistical power due to the multiplicity burden.

arxiv-2602-11753.title: Building Intelligent User Interfaces for Human-AI Alignment Conference: Bidirectional Human-Al Alignment; April 13, 2026; Barcelona, Spain CCS: Human-centered computing Human computer interaction (HCI) CCS: Human-centered computing Visualization
arxiv-2602-11753.creator: Danqing Shi
arxiv-2602-11753.description: Abstract . Aligning AI systems with human values fundamentally relies on effective human feedback. While significant research has addressed training algorithms, the role of user interface is often overlooked and only treated as an implementation detail rather than a critical factor of alignment.

arxiv-2602-19627.title: A unified study of nuclear physics and dark matter constraints through gravitational-wave observations of binary neutron star mergers
arxiv-2602-19627.creator: Nina Kunert 1,2,3, Guilherme Grams 3, William Newton 4, Edoardo Giangrandi 3,5, Anna Puecher 3 ,, Hauke Koehn 3, Violetta Sagun 6, Tim Dietrich 3,7
arxiv-2602-19627.description: Abstract Understanding the properties of strongly interacting matter at extreme densities is a central problem in fundamental physics, but neutron star mergers provide a natural laboratory for probing this regime. However, the complexity of the merger process complicates the interpretation of the associated gravitational-wave and electromagnetic signals.

arxiv-2602-20612.title: Non-Clifford symmetry protected topological higher-order cluster states in multi-qubit measurement-based quantum computation
arxiv-2602-20612.creator: Motohiko Ezawa
arxiv-2602-20612.description: Abstract A cluster state is a strongly entangled state, which is a source of measurement-based quantum computation. It is generated by applying controlled-Z (CZ) gates to the state | + + ⋯ + ⟩ \left|++\cdots+\right\rangle . It is protected by the ℤ 2 even × ℤ 2 odd \mathbb{Z}_{2}^{\text{even}}\times\mathbb{Z}_{2}^{\text{odd}} symmetry.

pmc-10668553.title: Virulence genes identification in Salmonella enterica isolates from humans, crocodiles, and poultry farms from two regions in Colombia
pmc-10668553.creator: Julieth Michel Petano-Duque, Valentina Rueda-García, Iang Schroniltgen Rondón-Barragán
pmc-10668553.description: Background and Aim:Salmonella spp. is frequently found in the digestive tract of birds and reptiles and transmitted to humans through food. Salmonellosis is a public health problem because of pathogenicity variability in strains for virulence factors. This study aimed to identify the virulence genes in Salmonella isolates from humans, crocodiles, broiler cloacas, and broiler carcasses from two departments of Colombia.

pmc-10742855.title: Gel Polymer Electrolytes for Lithium-Ion Batteries Enabled by Photo Crosslinked Polymer Network
pmc-10742855.creator: Kyeongsik Kim, Wookil Chae, Jaehyeon Kim, Choongik Kim, Taeshik Earmme, Teodora Staicu, Marin Micutz
pmc-10742855.description: We demonstrate a gel polymer electrolyte (GPE) featuring a crosslinked polymer matrix formed by poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate (PEGDA) and dipentaerythritol hexaacrylate (DPHA) using the radical photo initiator via ultraviolet (UV) photopolymerization for lithium-ion batteries. The two monomers with acrylate functional groups undergo chemical crosslinking, resulting in a three-dimensional structure capable of absorbing liquid electrolytes to form a gel.

pmc-11325567.title: The effect of prenatal education on health anxiety of primigravid women
pmc-11325567.creator: Sahar Nikoozad, Faranak Safdari - Dehcheshmeh, Farangis Sharifi, Forouzan Ganji
pmc-11325567.description: Background and aimHealth anxiety is a mental disorder that characterized by an excessive fear about health and physical symptoms. High anxiety in pregnancy is associated with adverse outcomes. The aim of this study was to investigate the effect of prenatal education on health anxiety of primigravid women.MethodsThe present study was quasi-experimental study.

pmc-11508928.title: Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS) in Pancreatic Surgery: The Surgeon’s Point of View
pmc-11508928.creator: Fabio Longo, Edoardo Panza, Lorenzo Rocca, Beatrice Biffoni, Chiara Lucinato, Marco Cintoni, Maria Cristina Mele, Valerio Papa, Claudio Fiorillo, Giuseppe Quero, Davide De Sio, Roberta Menghi, Sergio Alfieri, Lodovica Langellotti
pmc-11508928.description: Pancreatic surgery is complex and associated with higher rates of morbidity and mortality compared to other abdominal surgeries. Over the past decade, the introduction of new technologies, such as minimally invasive approaches, improvements in multimodal treatments, advancements in anesthesia and perioperative care, and better management of complications, have collectively improved patient outcomes after pancreatic surgery.

pmc-11539630.title: Variations in Trauma Education Practices Across Emergency Medicine Residencies: Insights from a National Survey of Program Directors
pmc-11539630.creator: Stephanie Stroever, Colten Lanning, Miloš Buhavac, Cameran Mecham, Andrea Weitz, Frank Frankovsky, Andres Rios, James Morris
pmc-11539630.description: PurposeCare of the acutely injured trauma patient is integral to the practice of emergency medicine. It is currently unknown how most emergency medicine residencies structure their residents’ trauma experience and little guidance for competency assessment is provided by the Residency Review Committee. Our study aimed to determine current emergency medicine residency practices in trauma resuscitation.

pmc-11712604.title: Clusters of modifiable risk factors provide resilience to the cognitive effects of β‐amyloid pathology in aging
pmc-11712604.creator: Mohini Bhade, Stefania Pezzoli, Joseph Giorgio, Tyler J Ward, Susan M Landau, William J Jagust
pmc-11712604.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundAlthough it has been estimated that modifiable risk factors account for around 40% of population variability in dementia risk, understanding how risk factors are related to one another and to brain pathology and cognition has been challenging.

pmc-13473585.title: Disruption of microtubules with low intensity ultrasound rescues hair follicle damage by paclitaxel in mouse models
pmc-13473585.creator: Celina Amaya, Shihua Luo, Elizabeth R. Smith, Jeremy Cheret, Matthew P. Schlumbrech, Tongyu C. Wikramanayake, Ralf Paus, Xiang-Xi Xu
pmc-13473585.description: Paclitaxel exemplifies one of the key taxanes, a group of versatile and effective drugs commonly used in chemotherapy for several major cancer types. These drugs work by stabilizing cellular microtubules, a unique mechanism to account for their impressive success in oncology.

pmc-13654126.title: Percutaneous retrieval of an embolized inferior vena cava filter from the pulmonary artery: a case description
pmc-13654126.creator: Zhi-Xiang Yu, Yuan-Yuan Yu, Rui-Tao Li, Xiang Li, Zhen-Gang Zhao, Yuan Feng
pmc-13654126.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ssociated with certain complications, such as tilt, migration, and fracture (3).Embolization of an IVC filter into the cardiac chambers or pulmonary arteries is exceedingly rare due to the inherent anchorage provided by the filter hooks. In this report, we present a rare case of IVC filter embolization resulting from incorrect device orientation during deployment and the successful retrieval of the embolized device from the pulmonary artery through the use of percutaneous endovascular techniques.
